title: Make it a skill
caption: Hands-on 2: turn your run into a skill, then prove it on a new web page.

steps.first: Step “Write the skill”: your spec and quiz note become a SKILL.md.
steps.second: Step “Try the skill”: give it a new web page and nothing else, then play the quiz it builds.
steps.third: Carry the lessons of that run back into your SKILL.md.
steps.fourth: Ahead? Run it once more on a PDF, or try step “Let an agent grade it”.

done: A second quiz, built in one go from your skill.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: Today’s Workflow, “Turn a source into a quiz”, is already picked. Each step has its prompt to copy, for an AI chat or a coding agent; paste each result back into its box.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

chats.openAIChatTip: Open an empty {chat} chat in a new tab, then paste the prompt

help.step: Improve: Write the skill, then Try the skill

talking-points.description: The red thread lands here: the run by hand took an afternoon, the skill takes one step. Anyone without a second article takes the fallback source from the Workflow.
